registryEntry.label: Create/Verify CMMC Defender Antivirus Policy via Intune
registryEntry.get_command: (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/deviceManagement/deviceConfigurations?$expand=assignments').value | Where-Object { ($_.displayName -eq 'CMMC-Defender-AntivirusPolicy') -or ((@('#microsoft.graph.windows10GeneralConfiguration','#microsoft.graph.windows10EndpointProtectionConfiguration') -contains $_.'@odata.type') -and (@('quick','full') -contains $_.defenderScanType) -and (@('everyday','sunday','monday','tuesday','wednesday','thursday','friday','saturday') -contains $_.defenderSystemScanSchedule) -and (@($_.defenderScheduledScanTime | Where-Object { $_ }).Count -gt 0) -and (@($_.assignments | Where-Object { $_ }).Count -gt 0)) } | Sort-Object { $_.displayName -ne 'CMMC-Defender-AntivirusPolicy' } | Select-Object -First 1 | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
registryEntry.set_command: $existing = Get-MgDeviceManagementDeviceConfiguration -All | Where-Object {$_.DisplayName -eq 'CMMC-Defender-AntivirusPolicy'}; if (-not $existing) { $policy = @{ '@odata.type' = '#microsoft.graph.windows10EndpointProtectionConfiguration'; displayName = 'CMMC-Defender-AntivirusPolicy'; description = 'CMMC L2 required Defender antivirus and scheduled scan configuration'; defenderScanType = 'full'; defenderScheduledScanTime = '02:00'; defenderScheduledQuickScanTime = '06:00'; defenderDaysBeforeDeletingQuarantinedMalware = 30; defenderSignatureUpdateIntervalInHours = 4; defenderMonitorFileActivity = 'monitorAllFiles'; defenderCloudBlockLevel = 'high'; defenderSystemScanSchedule = 'sunday' }; $created = New-MgDeviceManagementDeviceConfiguration -BodyParameter $policy; Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri "https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/deviceManagement/deviceConfigurations/$($created.Id)/assign" -Body (@{assignments=@(@{target=@{'@odata.type'='#microsoft.graph.groupAssignmentTarget';groupId='{cuiGroupId}'}})} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10) -ContentType 'application/json' | Out-Null; $created | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 } else { Write-Output 'Policy already exists - skipping creation' }
